project.name: the-t-house
project.productType: Creative music studio and video website

patterns: Shared 3D stage with orbiting portrait links
Card half-turn followed by viewport expansion

must: Use real route links and honour system and site motion preferences
Keep the image-derived studio mark compact and use signature red for decorative details
avoid: Autoplay and navigation triggered by swiping or focus

decisions.decision: Adapt Warp Carousel's ring motion for four upright 1:2 portrait links. Warm copper surfaces have pale rims and a red front-card accent. Keep manual browsing, the 180° flip and route zoom, and the native scroll-snap rail as the fallback.
Use the Engraved Copper finish with a brushed bronze grain, warm artwork, etched house lines and one light sweep on the front card.

Build the site around the supplied logo's white house elevation, red lettering and dark walnut backdrop. Keep the source mark at a compact size. Use Explora for short red display titles and Barlow for navigation, body text, full episode titles and metadata.
decisions.source: User-supplied T-House JPEG and approved logo-led website restyle plan
